answer_1.quote: We propose a new task of automatic citation text generation in scholarly papers.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models with ROUGE, reporting the F1 scores for ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: Three graduate students are employed to rate the citation text produced by each method in four aspects: readability, content, coherence and overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters scored on a scale from 1 to 5 for readability, content, coherence, and overall quality.
